messages.content: Suggest a 4 days Manali holiday package from Delhi with return travel fares and hotel stays from budget hostel to luxury resort.

🏔️ **Manali & Solang Valley (Himachal Pradesh) Holiday Package (4 Days / 3 Nights)** *Snow-Capped Peaks, Pine Forests & Adventure Sports* 📍 **Origin Source:** Delhi | 👥 **Travelers:** 1 Pax | 🗓️ **Best Time:** October to June (Dec-Feb for Snow) --- ### 🚆 ✈️ Return Journey Travel Options (Delhi ⇄ Manali & Solang Valley (Himachal Pradesh)): | Mode | Details | Estimated Return Fare (per person) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 🚆 **Train** | Vande Bharat to Chandigarh (3 hrs) + Volvo Bus/Cab to Manali (7 hrs) | **Sleeper:** ₹1,200 • **3AC:** ₹2,600 • **2AC:** ₹3,800 | | ✈️ **Flight** | Flight to Bhuntar/Kullu Airport (1 hr 15 mins) + 1 hr cab | **Economy Return:** ₹9,500 | --- ### 🏨 Hotel Stays (Categorized from Cheapest to Richest): | Tier & Hotel | Rating | Price / Night | Total Hotel (3 Nights) | Key Amenities | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- | | **Budget / Backpacker Hostel**
*The Hosteller / Zostel Old Manali / Riverside Camps* | 4.3 ★ | ₹950 | **₹2,850** | Mountain View Dorm / Cottage, Free Wi-Fi, Bonfire, Cafe, Trek Guides | --- ### 💰 Complete Package Budget Breakdown (Travel + Hotel + Food/Activities): | Package Tier | With 🚆 Train (3AC) Return | With ✈️ Flight Return | Ideal For | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | | **Budget / Backpacker Hostel** | **₹10,250** | **₹17,150** | Rustic, lively mountain stay with amazing valley views. | 🎯 **Top Attractions & Highlights:** Solang Valley (Skiing/Paragliding) • Atal Tunnel & Sissu (Lahaul) • Rohtang Pass • Hadimba Temple • Old Manali Cafes • Jogini Waterfall Trek
